author: benaye
body:
*Completely ignore the post made by G0O/Dyah, seeing as he is no longer a member*

Hello, and welcome to Twix's LFM forum post. Twix is a team made by Benaye/xBen_ and Tixah/qmh. We're a competitive team looking to participate in tournaments and related competitions.

Infomation we need before we can accept you:

Position: Frontline/Midfield/Defence (Midfielders also skybridge)
Stats: To join, you need a minimum of 5 thousand kills
Communication: Can you use TeamSpeak 3 (what the team will be using to communicate) and do you have a working microphone (not needed but recommended)
Bridging: It is preferred that you know how to ninja bridge/shift-unshift bridge and even better if you know how to breezily bridge.
Cannoning: It is recommended that you can at least do one type of cannon before you apply for Twix.

Thanks everyone! Good luck with your application!

The Leaders of Twix.
